source_snapshot.items: SDMA Poison Consumption Handling with CRC Write
source_snapshot.procedure: Clear evidence, run sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 1 -s 130 -t 8 -m5, download/decode OOB CPER, and dump in-band CPER with amdgpuras -C.
source_snapshot.criteria: On the intended OAM, UMC/ext15/End-to-end CRC/Deferred and SDMA/ext62/GfxSdmaError/Uncorrected poison-consumed evidence must agree with in-band CPER.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL and generic; omits the supplied s130/m5 command and SDMA-specific paired CPER fields.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; held for mapping, paired-event cardinality/order and recovery.

old_problem: The source's clear/max-ID/single-attachment flow conflicts with its two-layer SDMA poison oracle, and the prior review elevated project bindings plus an unstated fixed event order/count into a Pending decision.
disposition_reason: The exact block/subblock/type/message command and literal UMC+SDMA field matrices make the purpose and PASS oracle reviewable. The safe review uses all newly attributable CPER material and same-OAM/time correlation, not an invented number or order of OEM envelopes. ED-11/12/15/16/17/20/30 support gating the injection on supplied target, tools, isolation and recovery without retaining Engineering Decision Pending.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2087, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, uniqueness and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2088 / Wistron-AMD SVM-00132-V003 / 65478846b4398361 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
`-b 1 -s 130 -t 8 -m5` is SDMA CRC-write coverage and is not interchangeable with the preceding GFX b2/m5 case or following SDMA ODECC case.
The Master row explicitly requires UMC ext15 End-to-end CRC Deferred plus SDMA ext62 GfxSdmaError Uncorrected/Poison consumed on the same OAM.
Complete authenticated pre/post enumeration and decoding of every new attachment resolves concurrency and multi-section packaging without guessing a +1 count or strict order.
Device 0, tool/decoder build, Redfish service, propagation bounds and recovery are runtime project inputs that must be bound before execution.
Exactly one attended injection is allowed after approval; preserve all evidence and stop without retry on wrong target, collateral propagation or instability.
No amdgpuras, CPER, Redfish, mapping, injection, recovery, reset, log-clear, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.purpose: Verify that one approved SDMA subblock-130 CRC-write poison action records deferred UMC end-to-end-CRC detection and subsequent SDMA poison consumption on one mapped OAM with OOB/in-band consistency.
required_package: Approved amdgpuras build supporting d0/b1/s130/t8/m5 and compatible cdump_analyzer
Authenticated paginated Redfish CPER entry/attachment interface
Immutable device-id/GPU UUID/BDF/OAM plus SDMA/UMC path map
Approved UMC ext15 End-to-end CRC and SDMA ext62 schema
Dedicated window, console/power, collateral-event limits and signed recovery
test_case.test_command: After read-only target/tool/schema/health validation and explicit point approval, preserve full OOB and in-band baselines without clearing them. Run `sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 1 -s 130 -t 8 -m5` once, retain complete output, enumerate all post-stimulus CPER entries, securely checksum/decode each new attachment, and run `sudo amdgpuras -C`. Do not use a maximum-ID-only shortcut or reinject.
test_case.expected_result: The one approved execution has an attributable complete evidence set containing target-OAM UMC ext=15 End-to-end-CRC Deferred and target-OAM SDMA ext=62 GfxSdmaError Uncorrected/Poison-consumed records. In-band OAM/severity agree, no unintended OAM is affected, and the approved post-health/recovery checks complete.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires correct immutable SDMA target, one exact s130/m5 stimulus, both literal UMC and SDMA decoded records, complete OOB/in-band correlation, contained collateral scope and signed healthy exit. FAIL on GFX or ODECC substitution, wrong OAM/field/severity, either missing layer, evidence loss, unexpected poison spread or unsuccessful recovery. Runtime prerequisite absence is BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Do not open execution until exact SDMA target/semantics, tools/schema, isolation and recovery are approved.
Require operator approval immediately before the sole injection.
Retain all existing CPER, kernel and BMC evidence; no clearing or deletion.
Stop, preserve and quarantine on unexpected record, device loss or unhealthy state; never automatically retry.
expected_evidence: Row/variant/hash, approved d/b/s/t/m mapping and immutable target map
Tool/analyzer/firmware versions, authorization and recovery plan
Complete one-shot command output and synchronized GPU/system/RAS health timeline
Authenticated full pre/post CPER manifests and every new raw/decoded attachment checksum
UMC ext15 End-to-end-CRC Deferred plus SDMA ext62 GfxSdmaError poison-consumed data on the intended OAM
In-band match, collateral review, final health/recovery status and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: At the first target mismatch, missing layer, extra propagation or instability, stop and preserve the unmodified evidence set. Do not repeat or clear; apply only signed recovery and leave the platform quarantined if its exit oracle fails.

source_conflict.reason: The revised collection removes log clearing and maximum-ID assumptions and validates the complete attributable CPER set against the SDMA-specific dual matrix.

blocked.reason: Command semantics and authoritative criteria are explicit; the remaining target, package, endpoint and recovery values are project configuration.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: SDMA/OAM identity map, compatible exact tool/schema builds, protected CPER service, isolated window, collateral limits and recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; SDMA CRC-WRITE POISON GATE CLOSED; NO AMDGPURAS, CPER, REDFISH, MAPPING, INJECTION, RESET, RECOVERY, LOG CLEAR, RETRY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: GPU/SDMA RAS, BMC and platform owners plus authorized operator
pending.unlock_condition: Bind the approved runtime configuration and point authorization; a new decision is needed only for an explicit project override of the literal oracle.

external_authorities.application: Requires evidence preservation, distinct SDMA coverage, parameterized bindings, injection approval, recovery and no retry.

project_authority: SDMA/RAS owner approves the subblock/message map and decoder; BMC owner supplies protected complete evidence; platform owner approves containment/recovery; human operator releases one injection and engineer owns verdict.
